steps.name: After the Rest…
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Helena] in 「Luria Village」.

steps.name: Helena and Kaina
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Helena] in 「Luria Village」, then go left from [Helena]'s position.
2. After the conversation, enter 「Oracle Chamber」 from 「Eidos Gateway」 and turn in the quest to [Iris].

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s, have you been resting well?
(Helena refills the empty cup before %s with tea.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Drink. It helps with fatigue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Helena. But there's an extra cup.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I said Her Majesty's message would reach you when the time was right, didn't I? That seems to be today.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Before that, explain those ruins in the sky to me.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I won't ask you to tell me everything. Just enough for me to understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Helena about the Twilight era, the gods, and the garden, leaving out the parts concerning witches.)
(As she listens to %s, Helena nods repeatedly in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: This world truly is full of mysteries. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Tell me, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Helena?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Will this affect Her Majesty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To be honest, I don't know. It doesn't seem to pose an immediate problem, but...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I see...
(Helena quietly raises her teacup and takes a sip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why can only you see the Atlas Garden?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I can't say for certain, but... Children with Silvaria blood have always had special abilities, as though blessed.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: An extraordinary memory, a talent for magic, an affinity with spirits...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I don't know if one could call mine an ability, but sometimes a feeling of déjà vu would lead me to a new artifact.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Ruins where gods dwelled in ancient times must hold mysterious power... After handling such artifacts for so long, perhaps some of it affected me.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: In any case, your explanation helps me understand why only I can see it, %s. If I think of it as ruins and artifacts...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I've heard something like that before...)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Now, it's time to convey Her Majesty's message...
(No sooner does Helena fill the other empty cup than someone approaches them.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Great-Aunt, it's me, Kaina. It's been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty?
(Kaina steps into Helena's arms and embraces her tightly. Helena tries to push her away, protesting, but her grandniece refuses to let go.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You're suffocating me, Your Majesty. Honestly... cough, cough. Would you be content never to see me again?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What a thing to joke about, Great-Aunt.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Forgive my poor humor. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Your Majesty, Aaron...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Great-Aunt, you needn't worry about that.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If Your Majesty says so... Very well.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Then I'll step out for a moment so you two can talk.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No, Great-Aunt. %s, would you wait behind the house? I'll be there shortly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Your Majesty. I'll go ahead.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.
(Kaina watches %s open the door and leave.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Your Majesty. No... Kaina...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes, Great-Aunt?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You seem different today. You usually send letters. For you to come all this way yourself...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Something important has happened...
(Helena approaches and holds Kaina in a comforting embrace.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's been so long since I saw you, and now I have to leave right away...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It can't be helped. Next time, I'll visit you. I've little else to do. And...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Don't try to bear everything alone...
(A red-haired knight watching the quietly flowing river turns at the sound of footsteps.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Argent... Hello.
(Argent quietly turns his gaze toward Helena's house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty has something to discuss with Helena. She asked me to wait here for a moment.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Understood. Please remain here until she comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Nothing major has happened. Do you happen to know a boy who controls an enormous magic golem? Someone other than Narsha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No Name and Licaria...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I heard you went to a place called Orcarium with Narsha. You must have met him there.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm searching for that boy, but his whereabouts have been unclear since he met you, %s. Where could he have gone...?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If you see him again, please let me know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty will be out shortly.
(Argent hurries to the front of Helena's house, then escorts Kaina back as she emerges.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Argent. I'm sorry, but please give us a moment. I have something to tell %s.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.
(At Kaina's request, Argent steps back far enough to be out of earshot.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all, Your Majesty. What did you want to tell me...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I told you Aaron was searching for witches. That he seemed to want something from them.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: When a witch kills another witch, she takes the other's power. Aaron wants that power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is he trying to do?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: He already has ample political power. He must want a witch's power because he seeks something beyond that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At first, I wondered if he wanted my throne, but that isn't it. He seems to want something greater still.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: An ordinary human cannot use a witch's abilities. But there are ways around that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: He would need to cooperate with a witch who has a particular ability, or meet a being with the authority to let a human wield a witch's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Your Majesty. Does that mean your vision showed Aaron going to meet a witch?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes. The time of their meeting is almost here.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. Every time I tell you something like this, I feel I'm placing another heavy burden on you, %s...
(Kaina gazes sadly at the Isar River flowing behind the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Your Majesty... Following this information should help Iris too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even now, I don't really understand what kind of person Her Majesty is...)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I intended to send a letter as before, but for some reason, it couldn't reach you, %s.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That's why I came to speak to you myself when you returned from Orcarium.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason? What happened...?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: There's no need to worry too much... Now, I'll tell you when and where.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: First, meet your goddess. Then go to Orcarium. Aaron will appear at the place where you once met No Name.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Only confirm whom he meets and what they discuss, then return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that all I need to do?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her Majesty's expression seems to have stiffened...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, do you know what else will happen afterward?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Aaron is no ordinary man. You must not be discovered. We cannot let anything else happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Anything else...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, what do you mean by anything else...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That...
(Kaina opens her mouth as if to explain, then presses her lips firmly shut.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. I must return now... Tell Dayna what you learn as soon as you've confirmed it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you... Until next time.
(Kaina steps back with an inexplicably lonely smile. Argent, who has been waiting, approaches her.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...Shall we return, Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes...
(At Kaina's reply, Argent meets %s's eyes and nods farewell. Then he points in a direction away from Laran Road.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This way, Your Majesty.
(As Kaina and Argent disappear, Helena approaches %s, who is watching them leave.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helena...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s, did your conversation go well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, for now. It's about something that hasn't happened yet...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: There's no need to worry in advance about what hasn't happened, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still feel uneasy. I'll just have to go and face it.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I see, %s... Are you leaving now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'll pray that all goes well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Helena... I'd better be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She told me to see Iris, so I'll head to the Oracle Chamber. But what happens if something else occurs?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Don't worry. It'll work out somehow...)

steps.name: Something That Must Never Happen
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then go to the 「Quiet Place in Orcarium」.
2. Watch what happens in the 「Quiet Place in Orcarium」, then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.text: (The moment the adventurer enters the Oracle Chamber, Iris greets them with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. Levi returned to Jiendia because of you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But... Pandora...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That couldn't be helped. Pandora will be relieved that Levi went back too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Everything will be all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But there's something I want to ask, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know how the empress of Silvaria gained her foresight?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've inherited Seres's power, but I can't know the past or actions of those who already had abilities before I received it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That doesn't mean I know everything that happened afterward either. I know only a tiny part of all that happens in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You've just met Her Majesty, haven't you? What did she tell you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Iris what Kaina said when we met.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She told you to go to Orcarium after meeting me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm worried about her saying nothing else must happen...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps that means... Though it's only a guess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The empress of Silvaria is affected by time and space. I don't know why that would be true of a human, though.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: For now, don't worry. Go to Orcarium. Even if some unplanned "other thing" happens, remember that I'm behind you, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll protect you with my power and that of Seres, who ruled over the moon, flowers, and growing things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. I'll be off, then.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I should have told you this first...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What is it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda has left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When? Before I went to Luria Village, she was still...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She left as soon as she learned that Daphne had deceived Pandora.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda has seen many people hurt and killed simply because she is a witch. Unable to bear it, she chose to hide for a very long time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then she met you, my adventurer, and her power gradually weakened.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wanted her to stay. But she left, saying her fate was to run forever.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She said what Kazno and Jeril were planning could bring an outcome none of us expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An unexpected outcome?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know what she meant. Let's discuss Hilda another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Iris. I'll be going. See you later.
(Iris waves goodbye to %s. Watching her in return, %s slowly leaves the Oracle Chamber.)
(As Iris starts to move, a sharp wind blows in from somewhere. An alien voice, as though not of this world, drifts between its currents.)
Lady Iris...
(Startled, Iris tries to catch the approaching wind, but it circles and slips past as though ignoring her.)
You can return. If only you wish to return, I can...
(The moment Iris's small hand catches the wind, the voice within it dissolves into an unearthly wail.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being born from my choice now dares to test me...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have to hurry...
(The adventurer stops in the secluded corner of Orcarium where they once met No Name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It hasn't been long since I met No Name. Why does it feel like ages...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's strange that Aaron would come to Orcarium, but according to Her Majesty's vision, he should be here soon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hide and wait.
(The adventurer conceals themself in thick undergrowth in a quiet spot.)
(Time passes, but there is no sign of Aaron.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When is he coming?)
(Just as boredom drives the adventurer to rise, someone's voice sounds in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: We've arrived. This way, please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That was close. I'd better stay hidden. Is that Aaron?)
(Two people walk into %s's view. One is Aaron. The other is a woman whose clothing looks out of place on the Freios continent.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, who has come so far from the Jiendia Empire on the Jiendia continent... First, thank you for following me here.
Please, just call me Jien.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is she? Wait... Lady Jiendia?)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: May I?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: You may.
(The woman frowns at Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Call me what you like. I don't expect to see you for long in any case, Lord Aaron.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Lord Aaron.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Yes, Lady Jien. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I know that Silvaria, the sun of Freios, has put great effort into relations with the Kingdom of Elias on Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: But I was surprised to hear that you also sought relations with our remote nation. Especially after the trouble we caused...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: If you mean the false Agasura siblings, that affair concerned our empire too. You needn't worry excessively.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I never imagined they would reach Eastland, though.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Sigh...
(Jien sighs and looks at Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Now, Lord Aaron. I know it was not Silvaria's empress who invited me here. It was you, at the heart of the council...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is Aaron plotting?)
(Aaron smiles in satisfaction.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I feel I've seen a contemptible smile like yours somewhere before, but I can't recall where.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Hehe. You don't remember?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: It must not have been worth remembering. In any case, tell me where my missing subject is.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: That is why I followed you here.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The inspector was taken by a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Aaron knows everything. How long should I keep listening? Something feels wrong...)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: You brought me all this way merely to tell me that? I already know...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: And I know that you're working with a witch...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Impressive, for the ruler of another nation to uncover such information.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I have a capable inspector in my service. You would do well to answer properly, for your own safety... W-wait...
(Sensing something as she looks at Aaron, Jien steps backward.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Lady Jien...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: This is what I felt when I was captured...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Would you care to explain what will happen to my safety?
(Aaron takes a hideous dagger from his clothing.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Th-that's...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You recognize it. This is what he used to take your time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who does he mean by "he"?)
(Aaron toys with the dagger, then cuts his fingertip. Blood slowly drips from the wound onto the ground.)
(A red magic circle forms beneath Jien's feet, and Aaron's fallen blood begins to boil within it.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You are certainly something akin to a Demigod, Lady Jien... You must have thought you could face me. But you overlooked one thing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know I'm supposed to follow the vision, but Jien will die at this rate. I have to save her!!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia!! We can talk later. You need to get away!!
(Unable to stand by any longer, the adventurer moves. At that instant, everything in sight stops.)
(Jien is frozen in terror. Aaron stands still with his blade raised. A world where absolutely everything has stopped.)
(The adventurer reaches for Jiendia, but their hand passes through her motionless body.)
(Not only that, the arm %s extended toward Jiendia freezes in place as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this? Oh... Is this what she meant by something else happening...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's as though time has stopped...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what should I do?
(As %s struggles with the situation, someone slowly approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, don't move.
(Arche reaches out and takes %s's left arm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, how did you get here? I thought you couldn't leave Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It seems I can enter places that resemble Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...But this can't be Pneuma... So...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer. Get hold of yourself and listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Kairos won't wake, and Chronos's hour and minute hands have stopped. And time and space have split in two around you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche? What are you saying?!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Focus!!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm sorry. There's no time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Close your eyes. I'll take you to Pneuma. Don't open them until I tell you to.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you open your eyes, you'll lose my hand. If that happens, even our chance to put everything right will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I only closed my eyes as Arche said, but my right arm can move again...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Let's go, %s. For now, in the time on your Front Side...
(Arche's voice gradually fades until it can no longer be heard, as though time has stopped and sound itself has vanished.)

steps.name: What Separates the Front and Reverse Sides
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You may open your eyes now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, what's happened to Pneuma?
(Opening their eyes, the adventurer sees Pneuma full of spirits, yet different from usual.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Can you see?
(The spirits, ordinarily so lively, move slowly. Some Aerura hang motionless in midair.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Shadows from somewhere have engulfed Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me Elysia...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. Elysia has done nothing. If Pneuma is endangered, Elysia cannot remain safe either.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Neither Hecate nor Iris can intervene in this situation. Outside Pneuma, everything is frozen, just as it was before I brought you here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: According to Iris, an unknown power has interfered with the Great Wall. In the form of shadows, it has affected even Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to see Iris.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Calm down, Adventurer. The moment you leave Pneuma, all of time will be thrown into chaos. Even the time you share with Iris...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As though someone were trying to erase the world's time and create a new one...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Gaia once told me of the will to create that a god held when shaping the world in the beginning. I can feel it in those shadows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Returning everything to nothing... Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, you heard what I said before we came here, didn't you? Time and space have split in two around you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: More precisely, a Reverse Side of time and space has been created...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The you I brought here is on the Reverse Side. The you on the Front Side remains in Orcarium.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... There are two of me?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Think of a mirror. Though it's a little different. You and your reflection move together in a mirror, but...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When the you on the Front Side moves, the you on the Reverse Side cannot. And when the you currently on the Reverse Side moves, the Front Side cannot.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Just as you cannot see both faces of a coin at once...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Still, you haven't become separate beings. You should be able to remember what happens on both sides.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Like when I existed in another time, another future?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can't say it's exactly the same, but it's similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know all this, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: For personal reasons, I've passed through sleep and awakening several times. And living in Pneuma, where the times of many lives intersect, I came to understand naturally.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, you must find a way. A way to make your time and Iris's one again...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm sorry. This is all the help I can offer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no, Arche... This is all my...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Irfan will be at the trial grounds. He will open a door to the place where that will to create was born.
(Arche smiles brightly and clasps both of %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Arche. I'll set things right and come back.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll be waiting, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...See you later, Arche.
(Arche sees the adventurer off toward the door to Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You'll be able to return, Adventurer...

steps.name: A World Split in Two
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」, then go to the 「Vigrid」 portal.
2. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 1」, then defeat [Radiant Sinmara Phantom] in 「Vigrid」.
3. Once you have met all quest requirements, turn in the quest to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: We meet again, %s.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You've heard from Pneuma's caretaker, I assume?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And you know this is not Lady Hecate's doing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At a time like this, is that really...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't interrupt. Hear me out.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The door to Etoile's Reverse Side was not opened for your sake. It was for Elysia.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: For that misguided will to reach toward Pneuma, a divine realm...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What was born when Iris crossed into the realm of the gods, willingly or otherwise, has now grown this powerful.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I am not blaming Iris. Merely explaining that she cannot act carelessly in this situation... Understand that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You have to go and resolve it. As Iris's mortal, you may be able to meet that misguided will and put an end to this.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You surely don't wish Etoile to be swallowed by it and remade into something else...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It rests with you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Head down beneath the Trial of the Black Moon. You'll see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Go quickly.
(Irfan watches the adventurer descend beneath the Trial of the Earth.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The true serpent has revealed itself, beyond a mere shadow...
(The moment the adventurer steps into the place Irfan indicated, Elysia's gray scenery begins to warp.)
(With every step, the distorted scenery fades further, as though swallowed by approaching darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dark everywhere, like the road to Pneuma. Oh, a light over there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The light should lead to a way out. Let's go... What is this nostalgic feeling...?)
(Following the light, %s watches the darkness clear to reveal a new place. An unparalleled desolation brings their steps to a halt.)
(Whatever happened to this town, its buildings are destroyed or reduced to ugly remnants.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What happened here? I'd better investigate.)
(Just as the adventurer moves to explore, cold, sharp metal touches the back of their neck.)
Walk straight to the wall. Now...
(A woman's low voice sounds, apparently belonging to the sword's wielder.)
Do as I say. Answer only what I ask. Nod if you understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll cooperate for now and look for a chance to get free.)
(When the adventurer nods, the sword draws back slightly.)
Tell me who you are and where you came from.
Who? %s?
(Startled by %s's name, the woman asks again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, %s... I came from a place called Etoile to resolve what's happened to me.
Etoile? The Jiendia continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Jiendia?
I'll lower my sword. Turn around and look at me, %s...
(Hearing the woman's voice soften, the adventurer cautiously turns.)
(Their eyes meet those of a woman dressed in what looks like traditional Elias clothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Who are you?
(A smile gradually replaces the woman's stern expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this déjà vu...? I've never seen her before, yet she feels familiar...)
(Tears begin to gather in the woman's eyes. Her sudden weeping leaves %s bewildered.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right? What's wrong?
(Watching the woman cry, %s suddenly begins shedding tears as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... Why am I crying?
Don't cry, %s.
(The woman approaches and wipes away the tears. The adventurer startles and steps back, but she extends a reassuring hand.)
I understand. It must feel strange. Someone who seems like a stranger feels familiar to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know...? Are you a god too?
I'm no god. Just an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say that, but you speak as though you've read my mind. We've met before, haven't we?
Yes... You've seen me before. You remembered. I thought you'd never remember again...
Some versions of you would have known me all along. Others would remember me as someone they briefly met by chance.
The you standing before me may not be the person in my memories... Still, you came here of your own will. And you've met me as I am now.
And I want you to remember. Please don't forget. My name is Ellie...
(The moment the woman reveals her name, %s's mind begins to reel. A flood of memories pours in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this... Luminous?
(The instant the name Luminous is spoken, the surroundings darken.)
(Ellie quickly takes both of %s's hands. The darkness filling %s's vision disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don't have to force yourself to remember. The person you are now is wonderful, and more than enough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looking at her makes me feel calm. Why...?)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There's nothing for you to do here in [Vigrid] right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vigrid...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll make a path. Return to where you came from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't go back.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Has something happened in Etoile?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...
(Just as the adventurer begins explaining to Ellie, the ground suddenly shakes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?
(As the earth trembles, beings from other worlds appear where none stood before and approach them.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Where do they keep coming from?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do, Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don't seem willing to turn back...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If there's no helping it, I won't coldly order you home.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Come with me, %s...

steps.name: Vigrid on the Reverse Side
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, then defeat [Indignant Gullinkambi] and [Hungry Heidrun] in 「Vigrid」.
2. Turn in the quest to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Let's rest here. It won't be long, but we can catch our breath.
(Ellie defeats a pursuing creature from another world and surveys the area.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're all right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, you said this place is Vigrid?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If you want my story, tell me yours first. You haven't answered me yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I came here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Ellie why I came to Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: From a world turned to its Reverse Side, you would naturally reach another Reverse Side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then this place is also...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This is Vigrid. The Reverse Side of a place called Luminous City.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Luminous City was born from one person's wish for a world without suffering, pain, or sorrow.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Long ago, it was called Yggdrasil. It was the place Iris dreamed of while she slept, before becoming God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. Yggdrasil was nothing but a tree. You're saying it became all this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's difficult to understand. Odin and Nii met you in the distant past, long ago. But for you, that was only a few years ago...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Together with Nii, Odin built a town upon Yggdrasil, filled with the feelings Iris dreamed of.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: At first, it was empty. Then people from other worlds migrated and settled here. Children were born, and the streets filled with life.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I wanted to tell you more... But now doesn't seem to be the time.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There are more beings from other worlds than before.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Where are they appearing from? We haven't found a gate...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: In any case, we'll have to deal with them again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help too.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you. Shall we finish our conversation when we return?

steps.name: The One Who Waited for You
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, then defeat [Veteran Ganglati] in 「Vigrid」.
2. Talk to someone in 「Vigrid 6」, then return to 「Vigrid 4」 and turn in the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. Please continue where you left off.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: All right. Where was I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The town was full of life, with people from other worlds and children born here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Then I'll continue...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The bustling town seemed to shine with a brilliant light, so Nii named it Luminous.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin and Nii never wanted Yggdrasil to end. They wished for it to last forever.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But the weaknesses of an incomplete, unstable world will always reveal themselves.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's true of Luminous, and of Etoile. Those who desire a fate of destruction keep threatening them...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just as a gate to the Demon Realm once opened in Etoile, something similar happened here. More than once...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We had to do what we could. We sought a way to protect every life in the town we loved.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Without the people's knowledge, we split the world in two and made a space separate from Luminous. Though both are still within Yggdrasil...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Then we drew the World Tree's roots into that space and planted them there.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: A place the same as Luminous, yet different. We created a Reverse Side, so outside threats could arrive only there...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Even if invaders from other worlds entered, they would be unable to leave this place, Luminous's Reverse Side.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And so this became [Vigrid], the battlefield where we resist outside invasion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A battlefield...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why there are no people, and the buildings are ruined...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Those who want the worlds to end keep trying to connect them. The more they do, the more the Great Wall shakes...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's also why Luminous, which had kept some distance, gradually drew closer to Etoile.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin told me of a Demigod who claimed to have blown this place away with their own power. That's impossible.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If it could have ended so easily, none of us would have suffered...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I don't want to lose this place, where the people I cherish live...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Follow me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There's someone who wants to see you...
(The pair passes through the yard of a small house that once seems to have been someone's home, arriving at a new place.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We're here. This is it...
(Behind the ruins of a gray building stands a single tree with glowing blue leaves.)
(A breeze stirs the blue leaves as though welcoming %s.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This tree is Lerad.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Can't you feel the World Tree's presence?
(Ellie approaches the blue tree, Lerad, and strokes its trunk.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you for holding on today too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? It feels safe here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That...
Ellie, may I explain instead?
(A woman with long, shimmering hair slowly emerges from behind Lerad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're... Nii?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's been a while, %s...
(Nii approaches the adventurer and gently embraces them.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Across so much time, shifting space, and dimensions we couldn't reach... To see you again makes me happy.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: For some versions of you, it may have been a short time. For others, a very long one. But we've met again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's good to see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're saying the same things as Ellie.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Hehe, am I? I can't help it. I can say them because you're more special than anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You keep saying that. It's a little embarrassing...
(Nii smiles softly and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Hehe. That's enough greetings. Look at Lerad, %s.
(The tree, a little taller than a person, stands firmly with an air of strength.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Lerad isn't large, but it reaches powerfully toward the sky. Standing at Vigrid's heart, it supports Luminous.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: If Lerad breaks, Luminous will collapse. In the worst case, you, I, and this little world we love could be reduced to rubble.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Then we would scatter into space and fall onto Etoile.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that what Ouroboros wants?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Half right, half wrong. Ouroboros wants everything to disappear, but it doesn't desire destruction.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Vigrid is being destroyed because Ouroboros's will has encountered the will of the Absolute.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Ouroboros should have been found as a card. Instead, it roams through many places and times.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It must have left traces everywhere. I imagine you've encountered them too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The serpent shadow...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know so much?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Have you forgotten? I'm Luminous City's guardian.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I was once a dragon fated to destroy the World Tree... But thanks to you, I overcame that fate and am here now. That's why Odin and I are always grateful to you, %s.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: So don't feel burdened. Finish what you need to do and return to your own time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Nii. I'd like to greet Odin too. Where is he?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: He went to search for places where gates to other worlds might appear. Once he finds and deals with them, he'll return to Lerad.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: He should be back by now...
(Sensing something, Nii gestures for the adventurer and Ellie to stand back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nii?
(Black mist rises beneath Nii's feet, filling the space around Lerad. A dragon with gleaming black scales emerges from within.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That form...)
(The black dragon cries out at the approaching invaders, but they continue forward.)
(Having ignored the warning, the enemies are reduced to ash by the black dragon's breath.)
(Mist rises around the dragon once more, swallows it, and slowly fades, leaving Nii standing in its place.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm sorry, Nii. I didn't think they'd follow us.
(Restored to her usual form, Nii slowly approaches through the mist.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's all right, Ellie. They weren't following you. They were drawn here by instinct.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Wait...
(The instant Nii looks up, everything in Vigrid begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What's happening?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: A gate from another world seems to have arrived in Vigrid... Did it land somewhere Odin couldn't find?
(Sensing something, Nii looks around anxiously. Ellie approaches and takes both her hands.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Nii, it's all right. Don't be afraid.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...I was just surprised to sense several presences, rather than one. Death and fire, I think... In any case...
(Having calmed herself, Nii looks carefully at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: %s, I need your help.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Perhaps the task you came for has finally appeared. Finding the gates trying to connect to Vigrid...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Finding the gates...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Nii.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, %s... Take care of Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We'll be back, Nii.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, remember the path we just took? Let's go back and see what's happening.

steps.name: Death's Station
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, then enter 「Niflheim Station」.
2. Defeat [Hel] in 「Niflheim Station」 and obtain <Hel's Token>. Then return to 「Vigrid 4」 and turn in the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I thought we'd defeated every invader in Vigrid...
(Ellie looks sadly at the otherworldly beings wandering Vigrid in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(Where Ellie points stands a structure that feels unlike the rest of Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's a gate to another world...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thick fog pours from one, and lava from the other. Two gates have never appeared at the same time before...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Usually, one disappears before another arrives.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Those gates weren't visible before you came. They seem to have appeared together after your arrival...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As though they were waiting for me...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And something else is strange.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Until now, the invaders tried to consume or destroy everything in Vigrid, including Lerad.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But some of those creatures don't seem interested in that. They're examining this place. As though gathering information...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We need to investigate the gates...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, please hold off the enemies here and keep Lerad safe. I'll investigate.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Having you here makes me feel a little more at ease.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, someone's over there. Is that...?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: In front of the gate with the fog? Oh, it's Odin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin...
(As Ellie said, a man with the lonely air of a wolf stands nearby, gazing at the gate.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Leave this to me. If anything seems even slightly wrong, come back here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Understood? You must come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much, Ellie. I'll be back.
(An enormous structure resembling the entrance to a railway station stands alone within Vigrid.)
(In front of it, a man with mysterious mismatched eyes looks up at the sign attached to the structure.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Niflheim...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...
(Odin turns at the sound of %s's approaching voice.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It's you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...
(Facing Odin, %s recalls many different versions of him.)
(The confident chief god of the white world, and the chairman coldly overseeing Valhalla Academy.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s... I should have made sure you never had to come to Vigrid...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I know how you came here. The distortion of time must have guided you...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If I were stronger as this world's chief god, I could have defied fate and kept this from happening to you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Odin. You're already doing so much to protect Vigrid. Don't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here to do what I need to do, too...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I never doubted Iris's reasons for trusting and relying on you, but now I truly understand. You've grown so much stronger and more resilient, %s...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I don't know if this will restore both your time and Vigrid. Still, we have to try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The world beyond this gate is different from those I've faced before. We need another approach.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Someone is waiting for us beyond it. That world's ruler. They don't want their world connected to Vigrid either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Any ruler who knows of Yggdrasil and Lerad understands it naturally.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: 「...When all the worlds drawn by Yggdrasil's power gather, war shall erupt among them. And thus shall come Ragnarok.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ragnarok...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Come, %s. First, to [Niflheim], the world of death...
(Odin slowly approaches the entrance to the world called Niflheim.)
(The mist of death pouring from within thickens, gradually obscuring his form in Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Niflheim... Somehow, it feels familiar. What sort of place is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better follow Odin inside...
(The adventurer follows Odin through the mist. A small figure watching from afar approaches the gate.)
Has even Niflheim's gate reached this place?
This is bad... I need to tell Surtr...
(The moment they step into the fog-shrouded world, a chill unlike anything they have felt before envelops them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's cold.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Niflheim's cold only feels like this at first. You'll soon grow used to it. But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Odin?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This isn't the Niflheim I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there more than one Niflheim?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is only one World Tree, but countless worlds that know of it...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Those worlds must never touch. When they do, only the powerful survive. The rest are fated to disappear.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: That is Ragnarok... Their war for survival around the World Tree. And the battlefield of that war is Vigrid...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: These worlds have devoted great power to preserving themselves. Just as mine has struggled to avoid colliding with Etoile.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As I thought...
(As Odin surveys the surroundings, a woman's silhouette moves within the thick mist.)
How unfortunate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that...?
(The adventurer raises their weapon warily, but Odin extends an arm to stop them. The figure emerges from the mist and stands before them.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Hel, ruler of Niflheim.
(A woman wrapped in violet light, seemingly the only light in this black world, approaches with clicking footsteps.)
(Hel folds her arms and studies Odin and the adventurer with calm assurance.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Neither I nor this Niflheim seems to be the one you know. And you aren't the Odin who sent me here...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Adventurer, I haven't met you in person. I saw you in a vision while hunting a space-time worm that fell into Niflheim.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: When another me was caught by that worm...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: In any case, enough introductions. Tell me why you've come.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: We must destroy this place. More precisely...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Say that again.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Exactly as I said. Ruler of Niflheim, surely you don't want Ragnarok to occur.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I built this place to welcome guests, waiting for a day of joy! And you ask me to destroy it? Uninvited intruders, no less...?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I won't let you ruin it. This place... This place!!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If more gates appear in Vigrid, Niflheim will collapse in an instant, Hel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't there another way?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The ruler of Niflheim knows full well that there isn't.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: This is my world. Niflheim.
(Hel closes her eyes. When she opens them, her red gaze begins to glow.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Wait, Hel!!
(Hel raises a hand and lifts her eyepatch. Black mist surges from behind her and races toward Odin and the adventurer.)
(The mist binds them, then hurls them toward the passage they entered through.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I cannot accept the demands of people who cannot even resist my power in this world...
(The scattered black mist gathers again. From within it, one figure who should have been thrown outside slowly emerges.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why weren't you cast out?
(Hel looks in surprise at the approaching figure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I had to hold on, and the mist dispersed. Oh, Odin...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Only Odin was thrown out, while you remained? I can hardly believe it.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I mistook you for the person in my vision. I apologize. You must be very different from that version of yourself...
(After a moment's deep thought, Hel quietly turns away.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Then I will hear your story. I need to know why you've come. Only then can I understand. But not here.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I'll wait by the road to Niflheim City.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: If your will is strong, you will find me waiting there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait, Hel!
(The adventurer reaches for her, but Hel vanishes from the spot, leaving only her words.)
(Meanwhile, figures that appear to be Niflheim's residents rush toward the intruder from afar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. So this is how she'll test my resolve... No choice, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait for me, Hel. I'll come and tell you everything...
(Each new section of Niflheim Station brings another blast of bitter, cutting wind.)
(After a long journey, the adventurer reaches the far end of the station. A passage leading outside slowly comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the road Hel mentioned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? The air above is cold, but the ground keeps getting warmer...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You feel it too.
(As %s bends to touch the ground, Hel's boots come into view, clicking toward them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Exactly what I said. This place is growing hotter. Because a gate to Muspelheim is nearby, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Now, you've reached me safely. Tell me your story. I'll listen.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why do you hesitate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Hel how I came to Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: ...I see. So you have your own reasons...
(Hearing %s's story, Hel quietly gazes at the river beyond Niflheim Station.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The place where a wounded god fell after exile held nothing but ice and the cold flowing from it. There was no sign of life.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: A god's duty is simple. To care for life, wherever they may be.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: It didn't matter if other worlds called this place death, or the beginning of hell.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Those who came here sought only to escape the depths of despair.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: So the god comforted those who endured the cold, and together they built Niflheim... Ah...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: But if the heat keeps rising... this world will vanish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That god in your story is you, Hel, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Yes. The story of this world's ruler. Now I must decide, before even the will that raised me melts away...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: This place was made for a day of joy yet to come.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: %s, let me give up myself to protect Niflheim. If that is how I can protect you and Vigrid...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?
(Hel gives the adventurer a faint smile.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Kill me.
(As Hel's smile fades, Niflheim Station begins to shake. The cold world fills with the mist of death rising around her.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Before I kill you. Quickly...
(The adventurer strikes with all their strength, breaking through the mist of death to reach Hel.)
Thud.
(Thrown far away, Hel rises once more, but her strength fails and she collapses.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why are you offering me your hand?
(Lying on the ground, Hel looks at %s's outstretched hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I don't think fighting like this serves any purpose.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Kill me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't. Not for a reason like this...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You didn't kill me in the vision I saw either. Even though you had the chance...
(Hel takes %s's hand and stands, then steps back and turns away.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Then there's no helping it. If you won't kill me, I'll have to kill myself...
(At Hel's words, the river outside Niflheim Station stops flowing. Water surges upward, engulfs her, and freezes her solid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hel? Hel!!
(The mist of death around Hel pushes the approaching adventurer away. Then it splits, parts of it turning into sharp thorns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no...
(The mist, transformed into spikes, rises like fierce ocean waves and pierces Hel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hel!! Hel!!
(The horrified adventurer rushes to the falling Hel. All the mist of death and cold surrounding her flows down into the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this...?
(The warmth beneath the ground vanishes, and cold returns.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: It's done now.
(Hel, unconscious a moment before, opens her eyes and smiles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth did you do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah! Y-you startled me! Don't do that so suddenly...
(Hel approaches %s, kisses their cheek, and watches their reaction.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why so surprised? Aren't you used to this sort of thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How could I be used to someone I thought was dead waking up?
(The adventurer backs away in flustered surprise, and Hel smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thank you, %s... for breaking the empty resolve I clung to...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Throughout my long years in Niflheim, I waited for that day. Even though I knew it would never come...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What day...?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The day I would meet someone precious again. I declared it my day of joy and waited, all on my own.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I knew it was foolish. Perhaps all those years had frozen my mind too... I think I needed something to break that spell.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Perhaps I should be grateful that I cast it off, even like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But are you all right? You really... died...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe. So that's what worried you.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: For me, here in Niflheim, death is endless... Merely a means of reaching a new understanding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel a little deceived.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Don't be disappointed, %s. You've earned my trust.
(Hel places something in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: ...Return and give this to Odin. Tell him I will not let that empty twilight, Ragnarok, unfold around the World Tree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Hel.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You may be the first person to enter the world of death and thank me. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Farewell, %s.
(Hel's smile fades. As she finishes her farewell, the cold-laden mist of death rises again.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Now, return and find the gate from Muspelheim trying to reach Vigrid. Until we meet again.
(When the mist clears, Hel is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Muspelheim? Oh, too late... I suppose I can go back now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling...?
(Something different reaches the adventurer from Niflheim Station, which until now had felt only cold.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's Hel's influence, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go outside and tell Ellie and Odin. Then we'll head to Muspelheim's gate...

steps.name: Beating the Heat
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, then meet [Nii] in [Vigrid 6].
2. Once you have met all requirements, press the Complete Quest button.

lines.text: (While Ellie rests briefly after fighting Vigrid's invaders, the ground beneath her suddenly shakes.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This tremor...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Stay alert, Ellie.
(Odin appears and seizes a zombie by the neck as it attacks Ellie from behind.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: These zombies came from Niflheim to scout this place. Ganglati, I believe they're called.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The moment they entered Vigrid, they lost their reason. An outside power eroded their minds as well...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Now they're mere monsters, craving life from within death and seeking to drain it from others...
(Blue flames flow from Odin's hand and engulf the captive zombie. They climb its body and reduce it to ash.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: My apologies to Hel, but there is no other way...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you, Odin. But didn't you go inside?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Perhaps because it was another world, there was little I could do. Still, Iris's adventurer seems to have persuaded Hel and resolved matters...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: That tremor proves the passage linking Niflheim to this place is disappearing.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: So Hel changed her mind...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I see. Then there's only one left, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: And here comes our adventurer.
(The adventurer emerges from where Niflheim Station's entrance stood and approaches Odin and Ellie.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, Odin. I'm back.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Are you all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm fine.
(Beside the relieved Ellie, Odin approaches and checks %s's condition.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I sense Niflheim's power strongly. If you've brought something back, show me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hel asked me to give you something. Here...
(I give Odin Hel's Token.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: To entrust me with part of her own life force...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean she'll share this place's fate?
(Odin nods quietly instead of answering.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It's the best choice in our present situation...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But, Odin... Setting everything else aside, how can we bring this to the ending everyone wants?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Only by keeping the one who desires destruction from tampering with Etoile.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: We cannot stop his will as we are now. All we can do is grow stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So we need to become strong enough to shake his resolve... That's harsh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We could worry forever. Come on, Odin. Let's go to the next place. Muspelheim's gate...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The lava flowing from Muspelheim's gate is no ordinary lava.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Only a little has seeped through, but if the barrier breaks, it will flood out. Enough to engulf all of Vigrid...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ragnarok begins when Surtr's fire burns Vigrid.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Surtr rules Muspelheim and its flames... A being born with the fate of burning everything.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: She doesn't want his fire to burn other realms either, so she must be struggling with this. But we have no way to enter from here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...
There is a way.
(A being from another world suddenly approaches Odin and %s as they deliberate.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Stop there, unless you want to be destroyed.
This is only an illusion. Destroy it, and another will come to you. So listen.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie, I'm sorry. Stand down.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You there. I sense Muspelheim's fire in you. Are you...?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: I'm Sinmara. You could call me Surtr's family.
(After introducing herself, Sinmara's illusion circles Odin, Ellie, and %s.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, you cannot enter Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I know, Sinmara...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Before the lava even covers Vigrid, a shadow wolf will break through the Great Wall, fall upon me, and swallow me.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The Bride of Heaven shall purify the world, and all sin shall vanish...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've heard that somewhere. Where was it? Oh...)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Though we do not wish it, the future of the worlds bound to the World Tree is written in the book of prophecy, [Edda]. A terrible account of worlds and their rulers burning away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edda?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I've heard there's a girl somewhere with a similar name. Never mind that.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: That's why this realm's chief god mustn't act recklessly. Send someone in your place. Someone who can withstand Surtr's fire...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, not that woman. An ordinary human will turn to ash the moment they step into Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie, I understand your resolve, but this is beyond what you can endure.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I understand. It's frustrating, but there's no helping it...
(Sinmara's illusion approaches %s and meets their eyes.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: You're the one who returned after speaking to Niflheim's ruler, right? Hmm, let's see. You really aren't an ordinary human.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: A human blessed by a god amid twisted, distorted time...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: If I pushed you into Muspels Tunnel, you'd survive. But you wouldn't escape serious burns.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try. I have to...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: You're more reckless than I thought. This isn't that simple. Are you trying to get everyone killed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Sinmara, do we only need a way to withstand the fire flowing through Muspelheim?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Yes, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All right. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie, stay here and deal with those corrupted after emerging from the gates.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Sinmara, %s. Follow me.
(Odin leads Sinmara's illusion and the adventurer to Lerad, where Nii waits.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I'm back.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Oh, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As you know, the gates from Niflheim and Muspelheim...
(Without waiting to hear him out, Nii reaches out with both hands and catches him around the waist.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'm working so hard to protect Lerad, and you leave me alone for this long? Hm? Do you know how long I've waited?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It took a little longer than expected. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'm generous, so I'll gladly forgive you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I've seen this before... Ah, why does it annoy me?)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: You two look lovely together. Or should I say, god and dragon?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Where did this cute little one come from? Don't tell me she's fallen for Odin...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Nothing like that. Older men aren't my type. You can keep him.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, little lady.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, there's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You want to ask me for something, don't you?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You rarely make that face. Tell me, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All right...
(Odin and Sinmara's illusion explain the situation to Nii and their need for power to withstand the fire.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Yes, I understand.
(Nii smiles softly and sweeps her hair aside. Taking Odin's hand, she places it against her neck.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Will you be all right doing it here? Even if it's my request...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, I'm always all right. You're beside me. Remember what matters to us.
(Nii smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii...
(Odin looks at her, then bows his head. Accepting her wishes, he lifts the hand resting against her neck.)
(Nii squeezes her eyes shut in pain. A small split opens in her neck, and a black fragment resembling cold, hard metal rises from it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: A black dragon's scale, darker than the deepest night... Hold that in your hand, and even Muspelheim's lava will feel cool.
(As Odin takes the scale, Nii's strength gives out and she slumps down. Startled, he catches her and helps her sit before Lerad.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Don't look like that. See? The wound has already healed.
(Nii points to her neck with a reassuring expression.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I never wanted to cause you such pain.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I was the World Tree's devourer, yet you let me stay beside you. That alone made you my world. My everything...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'll dream for a little while. Stay beside me.
(Odin nods, and Nii closes her eyes and falls asleep. Even in sleep, her hand remains wrapped around his.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: %s. Come here.
(Odin gestures for %s to approach.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Take this. As Sinmara's illusion said, hold it in your hand when you enter Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel a mysterious power in the black dragon's scale...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin, will Nii be all right?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: After a few hours' sleep, she'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, that dragon trusts you deeply, doesn't she?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I don't think Surtr's feelings toward you are any different.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Really...?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Anyway, Odin... Wish this one success. Let's go, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm counting on you, %s... When you return, come to where Ellie is, not here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood, Odin. Please take good care of Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If Hel trusts you, you'll find some way to talk to Surtr too...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Muspels Tunnel's gate is over there. See it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There it is.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: By the way, why have you been talking to me so casually?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I? Oh, I suppose I have. You were speaking casually too, so it felt natural.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Never mind that. Let's go. Getting me into Muspelheim is what matters right now.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: True.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: I feel like I've been had... %s, wait for me. It'll be less hot if you hold my hand going in. Hey! I said wait!

steps.name: Drawing Closer to Fate
steps.objective: Defeat [Surtr] in 「Muspel's Tunnel」 and obtain <Surtr's Token>. Then return to 「Vigrid 4」 and turn in the quest to [Ellie].

lines.text: (After soothing the grumbling illusion of Sinmara, the adventurer reaches the gate. It opens, and a blast of heat seizes them and draws them inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's hot.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Don't be dramatic. You have the black dragon's scale. You'll manage.
(As the initial heat passes, an endless road stretches ahead. Below it, blazing lava flows toward somewhere unseen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lava flows like a river...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: We call it the River of Fire, just as it looks. It sustains our world, but to other worlds, it is death itself.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: So we built a tunnel over it to contain and manage it. We cool the river, purify it into ordinary water, then release it outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you do that?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Muspelheim's lava is fated to engulf the land of the World Tree. But if it flows out as an ordinary river, there's no problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you can cool the river, couldn't you stop it? Then it wouldn't flow into Vigrid.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: ...Wait. What did you just say? Did you say you wanted to stop the river?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Oh, Surtr... Surtr?! No!!
(Sinmara's illusion darts about in alarm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?
(A woman dragging an enormous sword approaches from the distance, entering %s's view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that Surtr?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Stop, Surtr!!
(Sinmara's illusion moves forward to intervene, but flames have already exploded from the burning blade toward the adventurer.)
KRAAA-BOOM!
(Unable to dodge in time, the adventurer is hurled against a wall.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... uhhh...
(A sharp sword tip, radiating both heat and cold, approaches the adventurer's neck.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Raise your head, traveler from another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...
(From her short dark-red clothing to the dark-red horns on her head, the expressionless woman seems like flame itself.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I am Surtr, ruler of Muspelheim. State your name.
(Surtr closes her eyes upon hearing %s's name.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr, lower your sword. This person spoke of stopping the River of Fire because they didn't understand.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Sinmara, hush.
(Surtr gestures for Sinmara's illusion to be quiet.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, you haven't given me a false name, have you?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: (Surtr?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is my real name.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Very well, %s. As Muspelheim's ruler, I ask again. Do you truly not know what it means for the River of Fire below us to stop?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really don't. I want to understand why you reacted that way...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You aren't lying.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Then I'll tell you. To stop the River of Fire is to kill me, the ruler of this world...
(Just as Surtr's sword withdraws from %s's neck, an enormous flame awakens and dances in her other hand.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: That does not mean your ignorance is forgiven, %s...
(The flame rising from Surtr's hand plunges into %s's chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, h-hot!! Aaaaaagh!!

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr... D-don't. You mustn't...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Sinmara, I'm only doing what I can. For Muspelheim's future...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: S-Surtr... What have you done to me?
(Surtr watches the adventurer struggle to remain standing.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The black dragon's scale kept you from turning to ash. You're enduring it well.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You have little time. When the moment comes, the fire within you will burst like fireworks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this to me?
(Instead of answering, Surtr turns away. Sinmara's illusion follows, looking troubled.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: At the end of this tunnel is a passage into Muspelheim's city. I'll wait there.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: On the way, you'll have to face beings from other worlds that regard you as an enemy, and every illusion Sinmara has made.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: When you reach me, defeat me with your own will.
(Finishing her words, Surtr leaps into the River of Fire below and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I knew this would be difficult, but I didn't expect this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But something feels strange... As though heat and cold have both entered my body...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop overthinking. I'll go... and make her talk properly.
(Throughout the seemingly endless Muspels Tunnel, threatening beings fall at the adventurer's hands and vanish.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sinmara's illusions aside, the others don't seem to belong to Muspelheim at all.
(With each step, the heat within Muspels Tunnel grows stronger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's getting hotter...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: According to Sinmara, the river should be cooling as it flows...
(As %s advances and surveys the surroundings, an enormous gate appears at what seems to be the tunnel's end.)
(Approaching it, the adventurer sees the gate open and Surtr emerge. The moment her eyes meet %s's, she swings her sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surtr, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: There's no time. Defeat me first. Then speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Muspels Tunnel is getting hotter!!
(At %s's words, Surtr stops before launching her next attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has the tunnel stopped working?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what is it? If the River of Fire that makes up Muspelheim is you yourself, Surtr...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The fire inside me is growing hotter.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: When I awoke in the darkness and opened my eyes, I was given a purpose.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The rulers of worlds connected to the World Tree must fulfill their purpose...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Unlike other rulers, mine cannot be one of light and hope.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: My purpose is...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: To melt every being in every world with the flames of my beloved Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: For so long, I've struggled to avoid fulfilling that purpose. To defy my fate...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: It seems today is the day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surtr, wait...
(As Surtr swings her sword downward, everything around her blazes, including her red eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Such tremendous heat. There's no chance of talking like this...)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Traveler from another world.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: If you wish to witness fate, first struggle beneath the flames awakened in Muspelheim...
(As Surtr finishes speaking, the churning lava below the tunnel rises and surges toward them like a furious wave.)
(Only after the raging wave of lava sweeps through do the two come to a halt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This time, I have to block it properly...)
(Their attacks collide once more in a tremendous explosion. The impact hurls the adventurer away and onto the ground.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, just as you act for your world, I act for mine...
(As Surtr slowly approaches %s, Muspels Tunnel begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I... I'm dizzy...
(Severe vertigo strikes, and the adventurer can see nothing. They reach for something to hold, but find only empty air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So dizzy... C-cold... and hot... Ugh... uhhh...
Splash...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Ah, that's better... The dizziness is gone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The cold is gone, and so is the heat... It's warm...)
%s, snap out of it. Wake up! I said wake up!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sinmara? That sounds like Sinmara...)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 목소리
lines.text: How long are you going to lie in Surtr's lap?!
(The darkness surrounding %s disperses. The rough tunnel gradually comes into view, along with the River of Fire flowing beneath it.)
(The adventurer meets the eyes of Surtr and Sinmara's illusion, both watching them.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You're awake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surtr? U-uaaah! S-sorry!
(Startled, the adventurer scrambles backward. Surtr rises calmly, brushing lava from her clothing.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: There's nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. But, Surtr... Where are we standing...?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: In the middle of the River of Fire's path.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: A few hours ago, another world was prevented from connecting to Vigrid. The shock reached even Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You were exhausted, and the tremor made you lose consciousness and fall into the River of Fire's path.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr was startled and pulled you out of the River of Fire.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Even with a black dragon's scale, no living thing should endure that heat. Ordinarily, you would have melted away... But you...

lines.speaker: 수르트
