lines.text: Fell into it and survived unharmed.
(The adventurer looks around. They are standing with Surtr in a shallow part of the River of Fire.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: C-could it be the flame you put in my chest?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: That flame would have disappeared naturally if you defeated me. Then Sinmara would have become Muspelheim's ruler in my place...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr, don't say that! That isn't what I wanted.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I'm sorry, Sinmara...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Never mind. It didn't happen.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Fortune has smiled on us...
(Surtr crouches and quietly places her hand in the River of Fire.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The moment the otherworldly traveler fell into the river, it cooled. The heat inside me faded as well...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: At this rate, we can send purified water to other worlds too.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did that happen? The river cooling...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Across time and space, you have received many blessings.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The World Tree's guardian, the devouring black dragon's scale, violet mist that repels death, the power of earth that brings flowers into bloom, and the will of a girl who dreams of happiness...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, who are you? Who could be loved this much?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm an ordinary adventurer. Nothing more. I just did what I needed to do, and this is where it led.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I see. Understood.
(After gazing at the flowing River of Fire, Surtr rises and extends her hand. Sinmara's illusion drifts over and settles on it.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr, it's over now, right?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: For now, yes. The course of my fate has only paused, but it's over. And %s...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: When you fell into the River of Fire, a memory flowed into my mind...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me, Surtr.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Is the world you came from called Etoile?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: That star is calling other worlds to it, against its ruler's will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's clearly a dangerous revelation, yet I feel strangely relieved... It isn't because Iris is weak, or because she did something wrong...)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: ...I'm sorry. It was only a fleeting, uncertain memory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: And when you return, give this to Odin.
(Surtr takes something from her clothing and hands it to %s. It is a small badge with a rough drawing of her expressionless face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Surtr. See you again.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I hope we don't meet again. It would hardly be for a happy reason.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Goodbye, %s. Thank you. The exit is over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there it is. I'll be going, then.
(Sinmara's illusion waves after the departing %s while Surtr watches.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr, let's go home and rest. You haven't had a single peaceful day in so long...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: What is it, Surtr? Are you upset?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: No. Not upset. Something feels strange...

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You know it too, Sinmara. Ymir's world was... long ago...

steps.name: A Distant Fate
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, then meet [Odin] and [Nii] in [Vigrid 6].
2. Return to 「Vigrid 4」 and turn in the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Hah... hah...
(Beings from other worlds, driven only by the desire to destroy Lerad, fall beneath Ellie's sword.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There are too many... Huh?
(The enemies pressing Ellie suddenly stop. Then they vanish like smoke before her eyes, scattering into the sky.)
(As Ellie gazes quietly upward, she notices a rainbow hanging in the distant sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, I'm back.
(Seeing %s approach as though riding the rainbow, Ellie's eyes redden.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's over...
(Overcome with emotion, Ellie slowly approaches %s, opens her arms, and gently embraces them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: E-Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You've worked so hard...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thanks to you, neither the ominous mist of death nor the blazing River of Fire is drawing closer. Vigrid has grown warm.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: When did I last feel warmth like this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I can't quite remember. But Elias, when everyone was happy, felt like this. And Luminous, when the children could simply smile...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elias...?)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, sorry...
(Ellie smiles shyly and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I was so happy, I couldn't help myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Do you have something for Odin? Could you show me for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here.
(The moment Ellie sees the badge bearing Surtr's stern face, she bursts into laughter.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Pahahaha! Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Hahahaha! This is too funny... Hah... hah... Pahahaha!
(After laughing for a long time, Ellie wipes the tears from her eyes and catches her breath.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ah... That's wonderful. To think Muspelheim's ruler would prove herself this way.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It must hold tremendous power, despite its appearance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. The tension finally broke... Phew...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Shall we go? Odin and Nii will be waiting.
(Lerad's blue leaves dance in the breeze. Beneath them, Odin and Nii hold hands and gaze at the rainbow.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin...
(Spotting Ellie and the adventurer approaching Lerad, Odin and Nii smile.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Well done, everyone... And I'm sorry... This is all my fault...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Odin. Something bad happened. That's all...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: That's right, Odin. Something bad happened. Think of it that way. As long as we're alive, not everything will always be good.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: And we can overcome it soon enough.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, Odin. Believe that. You've believed it all this time. Keep believing it.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Ellie always says the right thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you too, Nii. Because of you, I entered Muspels Tunnel safely.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'm glad. I'm not what I used to be, so I was a little worried.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You used to be lively enough to destroy the world.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin! That's mean!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It's true... Ow, Nii! Don't hit me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Odin, Surtr asked me to give you this.
(Only after taking both Hel's and Surtr's tokens does Odin's tense expression soften into a slight smile.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This should keep Vigrid safe for a while. Niflheim and Muspelheim will be all right too.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: And Ouroboros seems to have stopped moving...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Odin...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: %s, I think your work here is done. Everything you needed to do in this place...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As this world's chief god, I've found a way to restore your time and space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You found it yourself, %s. I only helped...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, Odin? Oh, this is...
(Nii hands Ellie one of Lerad's glowing blue leaves.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: What are you waiting for, Ellie? Take it before it withers...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Call upon that person.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ah... Of course. That method...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: They will help you return to the Front Side of the time and space centered on you. Farewell, %s...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There's no time, %s. The rainbow shining over this place won't last forever.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Once you meet that person, you'll be able to see us again someday. For now, hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin, Nii. Thank you. Take care...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll see you later too, Odin, Nii.
(Ellie says goodbye to Odin and Nii and heads back the way she came.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I didn't think we'd meet again so soon... It means neither our time nor the world's has much left...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii...?
(Nii places a finger against Odin's lips and smiles playfully.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, you worry far too much.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: We only need to live the time ahead as well as the years behind us. That's why you and I are here.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All right, Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: When Ellie finishes and returns, let's go home too. To our beloved city of light, Luminous...

steps.name: Between Hidden Moments
steps.objective: As soon as you finish talking to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 4」, complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, wait here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no one here. Who are we meeting?
(Ellie smiles at the puzzled adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll call them now. Take my hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Ellie slips Lerad's leaf between their clasped hands. As they slowly walk forward together, the surroundings begin to darken.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Lerad's leaf has guided us to her.
(Ellie stops, and %s halts behind her. Looking ahead, they see a figure slowly emerge from the darkness.)
(A mysterious robed woman greets Ellie in a quiet voice.)
Welcome, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's been a while, Lili.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: I didn't expect you to come with the adventurer... Since you're together, the time must finally have come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lili?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, Lili helps Etoile and Luminous from behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Ellie, as I've told you before, I'm not Lili. I've only borrowed her appearance...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But you're also Lili. Taking her form and doing her work...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I call you?

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: If you must call me something, call me the mage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Mage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mage... The mage?!

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: %s, I wanted to thank you when we met. I always feel I owe you an apology...

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: For protecting Iris, and for protecting Vigrid...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lili... no, Mage. I feel like I've seen you before.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Yes. I know you. Perhaps you have seen me.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Since before you came to Belos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Lili, there's no time.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: I know. But this method will affect you as well, Ellie. Do Odin and Nii know that?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's all right. I was prepared for it...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Lili will stop your time here in Vigrid. You will awaken on the Front Side, rather than the Reverse Side. There, you must find and resolve what needs to be done in that time.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just as you closed Niflheim's gate in Vigrid and cooled the river flowing through Muspelheim...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Simply close your eyes and remain still. You'll return to the moment before time and space split around you in Etoile.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Mage...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Close your eyes now, %s...
(The adventurer quietly closes their eyes. Even Ellie's voice beside them gradually fades.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, will you do me one favor? There's someone I'd like you to give my regards to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I will.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: To my beloved kingdom, Elias... and to my little sister, whom I love just as dearly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, where is your sister? And what do you mean, your kingdom?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Tell her my soul still remembers and has never forgotten... And by my kingdom, I mean...
(At that instant, Ellie seems to recede into the distance, and her voice can no longer be heard. The adventurer sinks into a deep sleep.)
